name: tabvault
description: TabVault - High-performance browser tab stash with cross-PC synchronization and cloud backup

scripts.package:chrome: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist_pkg) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist_pkg }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist_pkg/tabvault-chrome, releases -Force; Copy-Item manifest.json, background.js, popup.html, popup.css, popup.js, dashboard.html, dashboard.css, dashboard.js, HOW_TO_INSTALL.txt -Destination dist_pkg/tabvault-chrome; Copy-Item lib, icons -Destination dist_pkg/tabvault-chrome -Recurse; tar -a -c -f releases/tabvault-chrome-v2.0.0.zip -C dist_pkg tabvault-chrome; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist_pkg"
scripts.package:firefox: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist_pkg) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist_pkg }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist_pkg/tabvault-firefox, releases -Force; Copy-Item manifest.json, background.js, popup.html, popup.css, popup.js, dashboard.html, dashboard.css, dashboard.js, HOW_TO_INSTALL.txt -Destination dist_pkg/tabvault-firefox; Copy-Item lib, icons -Destination dist_pkg/tabvault-firefox -Recurse; tar -a -c -f releases/tabvault-firefox-v2.0.0.zip -C dist_pkg tabvault-firefox; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist_pkg"
scripts.package:all: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
